spans.s:
चौर, अस्, ई, m. f. a thief, a robber, a pilferer; a
dishonest or unfair dealer, a usurper, any one who
usurps a position or a title dishonestly; one who
steals or captivates the heart; (at the end of a comp.)
anything bad of its kind; N. of a plant, = चोर-
पुष्पिका, used for the preparation of a perfume; a
kind of perfume.
—चौर-कर्मन्, अ, n. theft,
thievery.
—चौर-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, stolen, robbed.
—चौर-तस्, ind. from robbers, from theft.
—चौ-
र-ध्वज-बद्धक, अस्, m. a term applied to a
notorious thief.
—चौर-पञ्चाशिका, f. ‘the fifty
stanzas of Caura,’ title of an erotic poem by a poet
named Sundara.
—चौर-पुष्पौषधि (˚प-
ओष्˚), इस्, f. = चोर-पुष्पिका.
—चौर-रूप, अस्, m.
a clever thief.
—चौर-रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having the cha-
racter of a thief.
—चौरस्य-कुल, अम्, n. a gang of
thieves.
—चौर-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken by robbery,
stolen.
—चौरांशा (˚र-अं˚), f., N. of a metre
consisting of four lines of six syllables each.
—चौरा-
पहृत (˚र-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, carried off, stolen.

चौरादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चुर्-आदि), belonging to
the class of roots beginning with चुर्, i. e. the tenth
class.

चौरिका, f. (fr. चोर or चौर), thievery, theft,
robbing.

चौरिकाक, अस्, m. ‘a thief of a crow;’ (perhaps a
wrong form for चौर-काक ? or चौरि may be =
चौरी = चौर्य ?).

चौरी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has become a
thief or the prey of thieves.

चौर्य, अम्, n. theft, robbery, thievery; trickery.
—चौर्य-रत, अम्, n. secret sexual enjoyment.
—चौर्य-वृत्ति, इस्, f. the practice of theft or rob-
bery.
—चौर्यार्जित (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, acquired
by plunder or robbery.

चौरोल चौरोल, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?),
N. of a metre.
